definitions.gloss: breaking off a friendship; severing ties
definitions.explanation: Completely ending a friendship or personal relationship. A decisive, permanent break rather than a temporary falling out. Composed of 絶 (sever) + 交 (association).

examples.japanese: ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{絶交|ぜっこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I broke off my friendship with my best friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}られて→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶交|ぜっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I was betrayed, so I decided to cut ties with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{絶交|ぜっこう}だ！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}い{合|あ}って→言い合う：21474_iiau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲直|なかなお}りしていた→仲直りする：06307_nakanaorisuru⟧。
examples.english: Even when we'd yell 'I'm never speaking to you again!' as kids, we'd make up the next day.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶交|ぜっこう} implies a complete and deliberate severing of a personal relationship. Among children, 「{絶交|ぜっこう}だ！」 is a common exclamation during arguments, though it is often not permanent. Among adults, it carries more weight.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{絶交|ぜっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to break off friendship with ~)
- {絶交|ぜっこう}だ！ (we're through! — often used by children)
- {絶交|ぜっこう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of being estranged)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{断交|だんこう}→断交：21584_dankou⟧ is used for severing diplomatic relations between countries. ⟦{絶縁|ぜつえん}→絶縁：08374_zetsuen⟧ means cutting ties with family members and is more severe.
